• Repetition structure; executes statements iteratively. • Types: Do While, Do Until, For...Next.
Do While Loop: • Repeats while condition remains True; exits on False.
For...Next Loop: • Count-controlled with fixed start, end, and step values. • Automatically manages counter updates per cycle.
Nested Loops: • Loop placed inside another loop. • Inner loop completes full cycle per outer iteration.
